rationale: A unanimous, institutionally cautious merits holding is most likely, with the Chief Justice assigning (and often keeping) the opinion to frame the Appropriations Clause as satisfied by a statutory, capped funding mechanism and to avoid endorsing broader structural attacks. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Alito, Gorsuch, Thomas, or Barrett to emphasize original meaning, limits on judicially imposed annual-appropriations requirements, and Collins-style remedial restraint.
